**Current flows — v0.1.0**
Entry -> first available item -> question loading -> list / empty / failure.
Select -> Answer -> pending -> confirmed and locked OR failure (choice retained; Answer enabled).
Page or competition change -> discard current answers -> load target; page scroll resets. Exit -> discard answers. Collapse/expand -> preserve current context. Ten questions per page. Question-list Retry is distinct from proposed navigation-list Retry. Phone drawer, uncertain outcomes and keyboard/touch behavior remain open.
